lv_function.label: LV function
lv_function.note: Review qualitative contraction only; exact report EF is study context, not a local verified number.

lv_wall_thickness.label: LV wall thickness
lv_wall_thickness.note: Septal, posterior and whole-wall thickening have different causes, so they are different values. Increased: the report calls the septum and the posterior wall thick, or the walls together. Septum only: it calls the septum thick and the posterior wall was measured but not called thick; not claimed in a view that does not list the septum, or when the report states concentric hypertrophy. Posterior wall only: it calls the posterior wall alone thick; claimed only where that wall is seen (PLAX, PLAX_DEEP, A3C, PSAX_BASAL) and says nothing of the other walls.

septal_bulge.label: Basal septal bulge
septal_bulge.note: A localized thickening of the basal septum: not a thick septum and not LV hypertrophy, so a finding of its own.

pericardial_effusion.label: Pericardial effusion
pericardial_effusion.note: No global absence inferred from a partly imaged pericardium.

ivc_collapse.label: IVC collapse
ivc_collapse.note: Needs an IVC-focused loop covering respiration; Worksheet Inspiratory Collapse is entirely empty in the audited export.

mitral_regurgitant_jet.label: Mitral regurgitant jet

values.not_demonstrated: No jet demonstrated in this acquisition

mitral_regurgitant_jet.note: Presence/absence in this acquisition only; no integrated severity.

aortic_regurgitant_jet.label: Aortic regurgitant jet

values.not_demonstrated: No jet demonstrated in this acquisition

aortic_regurgitant_jet.note: Presence/absence in this acquisition only; no integrated severity.

values.not_demonstrated: No jet demonstrated in this acquisition

tricuspid_regurgitant_jet.note: Presence/absence in this acquisition only; no integrated severity.

pulmonic_regurgitant_jet.note: Presence/absence in this acquisition only; no integrated severity.

aortic_cusp_count.label: Aortic cusp count (en face)
aortic_cusp_count.note: Requires an adequately resolved en-face aortic valve; not a PLAX or apical cusp-count claim.

A4C.note: No routine aortic-valve claim; RA size and local wall motion are optional priorities when explicitly abnormal.

A4C_LV.note: LV-focused: the LV and this view's valves are prefilled. LV function, valve findings and wall motion are claimed, never chamber size.

A2C_LV.note: LV-focused: the LV and this view's valves are prefilled. LV function, valve findings and wall motion are claimed, never chamber size.

A3C_LV.note: LV-focused: the LV and this view's valves are prefilled. LV function, valve findings and wall motion are claimed, never chamber size.

A5C.note: The A4C structures plus the LVOT, aortic valve and aortic root. Requires actual valve/color-box coverage; no gradient or stenosis grade in a B-mode loop.

PLAX.note: Optional local effusion. LV function may be assessed if adequate; not the preferred isolated EF route.

PLAX_DEEP.note: The PLAX structures plus the descending aorta, and the PLAX findings. Pericardial versus pleural fluid requires landmark assessment; descending aorta must not be labeled aortic root.

PSAX.label: PSAX (cannot tell the level)
PSAX.note: The view classifier's class: it gives no level, so a clip of this class opens with no view and the reviewer chooses PSAX_BASAL, PSAX_MID or PSAX_APICAL, or this view when the level cannot be told. Only what every level claims is prefilled: no RV, no chamber size, and no LV wall thickness, which only the basal level claims. A clip at the aortic valve level is PSAX_AV.

PSAX_BASAL.label: PSAX_BASAL (mitral level)
PSAX_BASAL.note: Short axis at the mitral valve, the only PSAX level that claims LV wall thickness. No RV, no chamber size.

PSAX_MID.label: PSAX_MID (papillary level)
PSAX_MID.note: Short axis at the papillary muscles: the mitral valve is claimed here too, and the report's short-axis wall segments, which are mid segments, only here. No RV, no chamber size, no LV wall thickness.

PSAX_APICAL.label: PSAX_APICAL
PSAX_APICAL.note: Short axis near the apex: no RV, no chamber size, no LV wall thickness.

PSAX_AV.note: Valve/jet must be identified; aortic morphology is preferred en-face when systolic opening is captured. The pulmonic valve, proximal pulmonary artery and interatrial septum are prefilled too: untick them when they are not visible.

RVINF.note: Focused inflow view is not a complete RV quantification study.

SUBCOSTAL.note: The four-chamber subtype is prefilled; the reviewer switches an IVC sweep to the IVC subtype. IVC and chamber findings never mix.

SUPRASTERNAL.note: Arch observations only; spectral obstruction/velocity labels remain separate.

A2C_ZOOM.note: Zoomed: the base view's structures are prefilled; untick any outside the zoom (a tick means visible, even partly). Valve, root and chamber function findings are claimed, never chamber size.

A3C_ZOOM.note: Zoomed: the base view's structures are prefilled; untick any outside the zoom (a tick means visible, even partly). Valve, root and chamber function findings are claimed, never chamber size.

A4C_ZOOM.note: Zoomed: the base view's structures are prefilled; untick any outside the zoom (a tick means visible, even partly). Valve, root and chamber function findings are claimed, never chamber size.

A5C_ZOOM.note: Zoomed: the base view's structures are prefilled; untick any outside the zoom (a tick means visible, even partly). Valve, root and chamber function findings are claimed, never chamber size.

PLAX_ZOOM.note: Zoomed: the LV, RV and pericardium are not judged, and only valve, root and ascending aorta findings are claimed; untick any structure outside the zoom (a tick means visible, even partly). A zoom on the aortic valve is PLAX_ZOOM_AV.

PLAX_ZOOM_AV.label: PLAX_ZOOM_AV (zoomed on the aortic valve)
PLAX_ZOOM_AV.note: Zoomed on the aortic valve: only the valve, LVOT, aortic root and ascending aorta are prefilled and claimed. The classifier has no such class yet: a PLAX_ZOOM clip keeps its prefills until the reviewer corrects the view, and the findings this view does not claim then leave the candidate.

OTHER.note: No automatic report-to-local-caption routing. Reclassify or use separately flagged weak study supervision.

error_kinds.study_only: Study-level claim in a local caption

uninterpretable_reasons.poor_quality: Poor image quality or artifacts throughout
uninterpretable_reasons.no_cardiac_structure: No identifiable cardiac structure (crop, zoom or depth)

prefill_policy: Explicit report values only, routed by view, mode, structures and level. Each view prefills its structures for the reviewer to confirm or untick (a tick means visible, even partly); a structure is never added by the reviewer. Suggestions are MAL drafts. No review_completed prelabel, no missing-to-normal inference, no automatic ground truth.
scoring_policy: Score immutable original columns; corrections and confirmed omissions are separate, and a finding ticked among the prefilled findings without being prefilled counts as a confirmed omission. Cannot assess is not an error or a negative. An uninterpretable clip is scored on nothing else and gets no caption. A subcostal clip needs its subtype, and any other view has none. A view that refines the candidate's view is a correct view; the prefilled findings it does not claim leave the candidate, neither confirmed nor rejected. Exact report numbers remain context. Submitted review and exact input provenance gate release.
